Usage: xihan <command> [arguments] [--option <value> ...]

Commands:
  graph         Print the application's capability graph (forwards to 'dotnet run -- graph').
  help          Show the commands.
  invoke        Invoke an operation of the application (forwards to 'dotnet run -- invoke'); '<resource> <verb>' is a shorthand.
  mcp           Serve the offline XiHan Framework knowledge base (packages, manifests, configuration keys, docs) as an MCP server over stdio.
  migrate       Rewrite an application for a newer framework version using the rule set for its source version: migrate <source> [--path <dir|.csproj|.slnx>] [--fixers <ids>] [--dry-run] [--report <file>].
  operations    List the application's operations (forwards to 'dotnet run -- operations').
  pack          Generate deployment artifacts from xihan.app.json: pack [--manifest <path>] [--output <dir>] [--only dockerfile,kustomize,compose,aspire].
  pipeline      Print the application's pipeline (forwards to 'dotnet run -- pipeline').
  setup         Write the knowledge-base MCP server (and a usage skill) into an AI coding tool's project configuration: setup --client <claude|cursor|vscode|codex> [--mode mcp|skill|both] [--pin <version>] [--path <dir>] [--dry-run] [--check].
  version       Print the framework version.
  <resource> <verb> [...]: shorthand for 'invoke <resource>.<verb>'.
